+## Reproducible validation and supply-chain evidence
+
+Install the committed development lock without resolving mutable versions:
+
+```bash
+python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.txt
+python -m pip install --no-deps -e .
+python -m compileall -q src tests scripts
+flake8 src/huntx tests scripts --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
+python -m mypy src/huntx
+python scripts/audit_boundaries.py --check
+pytest -q tests/
+```
+
+CI generates `artifacts/sbom.cdx.json` in CycloneDX 1.5 format and `artifacts/provenance.json` as an in-toto statement with a SLSA provenance predicate. Regenerate the broad-exception baseline only after reviewing each new or increased site:
+
+```bash
+python scripts/audit_boundaries.py --write-baseline
+```
+
+## Source governance operations
+
+Configured static sources default to `approved` for compatibility. Sources carrying `discovered_from` default to `candidate`; candidates may be ingested for observation but cannot be published. Persistent decisions are not overwritten by subsequent config loads.
+
+```bash
+huntx --config configs/config.prod.yaml source-list
+huntx --config configs/config.prod.yaml source-transition SOURCE_ID approved \
+  --actor reviewer@example.com \
+  --reason "ownership and content review completed" \
+  --evidence review:123 --evidence probe:456
+```
+
+Approval requires at least one evidence reference. Retired sources cannot transition back to active states.
+
+## Native client release gates
+
+Secure publication routes default to `native_validation: required`. Set `HUNTX_NATIVE_VALIDATORS` to a JSON registry based on `configs/native-validators.example.json`. Replace the example executable and all-zero digest with the exact installed binary path and SHA-256 digest. HUNTX verifies the executable digest before every invocation, passes the artifact through a temporary file, enforces the configured timeout, and rejects nonzero exits.
+
+A registry can be tested independently:
+
+```bash
+python scripts/validate_native_artifact.py \
+  /etc/huntx/native-validators.json npvt persist/data/dist/route.npvt
+```
